text_blocks.snippet: Jardiance (empagliflozin) commonly causes increased urination, urinary tract infections (UTIs), and genital yeast infections.
snippet_highlighted_words: increased urination, urinary tract infections (UTIs), and genital yeast infections

list.snippet: Increased urination: Passing more urine or needing to go overnight happens as the Jardiance medication removes extra sugar through your kidneys. Taking your dose in the morning can help.
Urinary tract infections (UTIs): Extra sugar in the urine can encourage bacteria to grow, leading to burning or pain when you pee.
Genital yeast infections: These can affect both women and men, causing itching, redness, or unusual discharge.
Other mild effects: Increased thirst, joint pain, nausea, and upper respiratory tract infections (like a common cold).
Dehydration: Fluid loss can cause dizziness, lightheadedness, or fainting when standing up.

Diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA): A dangerous buildup of acid in the blood that can occur even with normal blood sugar levels, showing symptoms like nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, and fruity-smelling breath.
Severe infections: Rare but life-threatening genital or perineal infections like Fournier's gangrene can occur.
Low blood sugar (Hypoglycemia): More likely if you take Jardiance alongside insulin or sulfonylureas.
Kidney issues or sudden worsening of kidney function.
